mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS id, PRODUCT_NAME AS name, BRAND_NAME AS meta FROM TB_PRODUCT WHERE STATUS_CD = 'NORMAL' AND (UPPER(PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(BRAND_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%') ORDER BY PRODUCT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT HOSPITAL_ID AS id, NAME AS name, ADDR AS meta FROM TB_HOSPITAL WHERE STATUS_CD IN ('ACTIVE', 'NORMAL') AND (UPPER(NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(ADDR) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%') ORDER BY HOSPITAL_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT STAY_ID AS id, NAME AS name, ADDR AS meta FROM TB_STAY WHERE STATUS_CD IN ('ACTIVE', 'NORMAL') AND (UPPER(NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(ADDR) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%') ORDER BY STAY_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.POST_ID AS id, p.TITLE AS name, m.NICKNAME AS meta FROM TB_POST p LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON p.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE p.STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND p.BOARD_TYPE IN ('TOWN', 'LIFE', 'SHARE') AND UPPER(p.TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY p.POST_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
